title: Refactor Detail Panel Tree Gutter Alignment
description: Refactor the compose sketchpad Details panel tree layout so TreeSection, TreeItem, TreeRow, TreeContent, SortableTreeItems, and property-layout tree items render with a dedicated hierarchy gutter and one shared content start column. Preserve TreeContext behavior, PanelSection usage, property row/value-column layout, actions, expand-collapse, drag reorder, and data model. Keep tree guides continuous across subtree height and independent from row gaps.
summary: Increased the default right-side inspector width, made steppers fill the shared value column and always render their current numeric value, and normalized shared property-control stretching so nested inspector rows keep one consistent control width without flattening the tree.
